PHM.title: PHM Q3 Earnings Miss Estimates on Lower Closings & Margins
PHM.claim: PulteGroup (PHM) reported Q3 2026 earnings of $2.53 per share, missing consensus estimates and declining 14.5% year-over-year. Revenues fell 9.8% to $3.97 billion, driven by lower home closings (down 8.7%), softer average selling prices, and margin compression to 24.8%. While net new orders declined 6.5%, backlog improved 4.1% to 10,298 homes valued at $6.44 billion. The company faces persistent housing affordability challenges and rising mortgage rates.

PKG.claim: Packaging Corporation of America (PKG) reported Q3 2026 adjusted EPS of $3.04, beating consensus estimates and guidance, driven by favorable pricing in the Packaging segment and contributions from the Greif acquisition. Net sales rose 12.5% year-over-year to $2.6B with gross margin expansion to 23.2%. However, the company faces headwinds from higher labor, operating, and freight costs. Q4 guidance of $2.81 EPS reflects anticipated maintenance expenses and seasonal pressures.
